svg.title: APC PLC step chain – timing diagram with interlocks (example)
svg.text: APC step chain – timing diagram with interlocks (change time 8.8 s, page defaults; steps as §4.10, signals as §4.11)
High = signal TRUE / valve energised. Accent = safety-related or start condition. Watchdog per step = 2 × nominal time (example) → alarm + stop in a safe state.
F-DI station door + light curtain OK
must stay TRUE in steps 3–5, else SS1 → STO
Start conditions for step 1 (all TRUE, else no FIN / message)
spindle stopped (n = 0) + oriented (M19) · tool retracted, coolant off
axes at change position, B = 0°, B-table clamped signal (3S1) known
accumulator p ≥ 7.3 MPa (else charge first – guide 25 §14)
station READY: pallet seated (air) + operator ready (I21.5)
station door closed + light curtain free (F-DI), no E-stop
arm down + at 0° or 180° + both pallets present (I20.4, I20.5)
oil level / temperature OK, filter not clogged, no drive fault
Watchdog per step (example: 2 × nominal) and reaction
1 door open 3.0 s · 2 unclamp 1.6 s (2S1 not reached → check pressure)
3 lift 1.6 s (arm up missing → POC, throttle, pressure ≥ 5.2 MPa?)
4 rotate 5.0 s (drive fault / following error → SS1, STO, brake)
5 lower 1.6 s · 6 clamp 1.6 s (clamped switch missing → no FIN)
7 seating 0.8 s (no air OK → ALARM "pallet seating", no cycle)
8 door close 2.4 s. Every alarm: valves to safe rest, keep data,
operator acknowledges, recovery in manual single-step mode.
Digital twin · values: web/apc.js defaults, guide 25 §14
